mapper.select: SELECT id, id_flight, distance_remain, time_remain, altitude, speed, latitude, longitude, time_stamp, create_at FROM route WHERE id_flight = #{flightId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO route (id_flight, distance_remain, time_remain, altitude, speed, latitude, longitude, time_stamp) VALUES (#{idFlight}, #{distanceRemain}, #{timeRemain}, #{altitude}, #{speed}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{timeStamp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE distance_remain = VALUES(distance_remain), time_remain = VALUES(time_remain), altitude = VALUES(altitude), speed = VALUES(speed), latitude = VALUES(latitude), longitude = VALUES(longitude), time_stamp = VALUES(time_stamp)
